# Protected FFI continuous-spectrum committed-output read

Depends on #825's pushed foundation at `codex/observation-browser-eq@4c235ed5`: one prepared TrackPostMatrix/Both spectrum owner, affine ordinary/removal admission, application receipts, private protected staged boot, early Unsupported guards, and accepted protected stream start/stop. #825 is stopped/superseded for attempt accounting; this issue owns one closable remaining outcome: `miso_engine_web_v1_spectrum_stream_read(handle)` returns actual nonzero stereo PCM and a matching owner/observation-generation/selection-epoch/checked-sequence identity through the existing fixed FFI staging. Protected boot remains private. Existing legacy stream reads remain unchanged.

## Scope and frozen transaction

Allowed production edits: `hosts/host-web/src/ffi.rs` only, with focused fixtures in its existing module test area. Reuse native `begin_observation`, `read_spectrum_stream_admitted`/typed protected read, and checked observed identity; no owner, queue, buffer, ledger, worker, host-core, SDK or render changes.

The order is: (1) establish a matching `LIVE_HOST` with exclusive-borrow availability before staging mutation; explicitly distinguish Protected from a verified Legacy host; invalid/zero/disposed handles or either borrow conflict return terminally; (2) acquire one Ordinary permit using the prepared cached read lengths; (3) borrow the existing spectrum staging and preflight known header, full two-plane PCM capacity and cadence before native consumption; (4) invoke the typed admitted native read once, never the lossy public compatibility facade; (5) for an observed window, check shape, offsets, end sample, `sequence + 1`, and actual owner/generation/selection identity before the first raw write; (6) write complete raw header/PCM, then publish valid lengths, stream facts/metadata and capture identity together with no remaining fallible lookup. A refusal or failed pack leaves previously committed bytes, lengths, token and identity unchanged. The native queue may already have consumed a window on a post-read token/end/shape failure: report that truthful admitted outcome, never promise rollback, re-poll, or label it a pre-consumption refusal. No ack may precede a drop.

Admission `Refused` returns the exact recorded refusal result and changes no output/configuration. Native availability is admitted work: Inactive/Closed → Inactive/WrongState; PendingApplication → Pending/Backpressure with pendingBoundary; Warming → Warming/Backpressure; Pending → Pending/Backpressure; Gap → Gap/OK with actual epoch/drop counters; Failed → Failed/RenderRejected with actual epoch. Availability may update status/history; it never claims a new successful raw result/identity. Only real Gap/Failed reset worker-side analysis history under existing rules. Successful Ready writes actual target/channels/rate/sample bounds and owner/generation/selection/token.

## Objective gates

- Seed nonzero committed capture/result bytes, lengths, token, metadata/configuration and identity. Under shared and exclusive `LIVE_HOST` borrows, invalid/zero/unrelated/disposed handles, spectrum staging borrow conflicts and spent Ordinary credit, compare every committed marker after refusal. Reserved Removal stop remains admissible.
- Private boot → start Pending → read before graph application reports real PendingApplication → render/application-take → nonzero stereo PCM read with exact raw-header token and observed owner/generation/selection. A spent-credit read preserves the queued window for a later admitted read.
- Header-short, left-plane-only, one-byte-short and exact-fit capacities, and checked token/end overflow discriminate atomic packing. Known capacity refusals occur before native pop; post-read overflow preserves committed output while candidly accounting for possible pop. Do not rely on truncated native `u32` pointer truthiness; inspect raw/TLS records.
- Real overrun Gap and source-generation seek Failed update truthful history without replacing the last successful capture identity. Legacy stream cases remain green.
- Focused fixtures; full locked `host-web --lib --features test-support`; locked host-web/workspace check, strict Clippy, format/diff, existing realtime policy/mutation gates. Use `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/home/bl/misofm/engine/target`. No benchmark or new harness.

## Delivery and evidence record

At most four coherent issue-wide implementation rounds: fresh Luna MAX rounds 1–2, Sol HIGH round 3 if needed, Astra XHIGH round 4 if needed. Each receives one independent fresh Astra MEDIUM adversarial verdict; fixture-only revisions count. After round four FAIL, stop and rebrief. Root commits exact-path green or candid useful recovery checkpoints before another tranche and synchronizes pushed evidence/GitHub. Record each checkpoint hash, commands/results, native-pop versus output-commit outcome table, marker comparison, reviewer verdict and remaining findings here. This issue supplies a reviewable source correction, not a deployable protected EQ; generated ABI publication and browser/SDK/app adoption remain successor work.

Decision/evidence: round 1 Luna MAX candidate is a useful, buildable FAIL checkpoint at pushed `cca627bd`; GitHub #826 body and comment were refreshed. Focused protected read tests passed 3/3 and focused stream tests passed 9/9; independent Astra MEDIUM review found release-mode raw-header omission (`debug_assert!(copy_live_record(...))`), inactive reads preemptively refused before the typed native availability result, and missing mandatory hostile fixtures. The implementation establishes exclusive verified host dispatch, one Ordinary permit, known-capacity preflight, one typed admitted native read and checked identity before output writes, but does not yet prove output atomicity. Strict Clippy reports four unchanged baseline style diagnostics; its gate is not green.

Round 2, bounded Luna MAX tranche A at pushed `e23068bf`: raw-header copy is unconditional after capacity preflight, and typed native Inactive/Closed classification is no longer preempted by the staging active flag. Five focused debug tests, one release raw-header test, locked host-web check, format and diff checks passed; GitHub #826 body/comment refreshed.

Round 2, bounded Luna MAX tranche B: test-only committed markers now compare meaningful raw capture/result spans and headers/tokens, lengths, full metadata, cadence/smoothing, window facts and actual capture identity. Focused fixtures cover both LIVE_HOST borrow conflicts, zero/unrelated/disposed handles, header-short and left-plane-only capacity, and reserved Removal stop after Ordinary read credit is spent; queue retry remains covered. Focused C2A tests passed 17/17, release raw-header test, format and diff checks passed. Remaining round-2 work: checked token/end overflow and real PendingApplication/Warming/Pending, Gap/seek outcomes. One independent verdict will assess complete #826 gates; any remaining work escalates to Sol HIGH round 3. Root checkpoint/push hash and remote evidence for tranche B: pending.
